items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: So that was the Three Rhythm Rascals. Arlie Crawford on guitar, Al Elkins on bass, and I cannot think of Leonard's name, he was on piano.

ctx.x: The three -- it was my unit, because I was the manager of the unit. They made me manager of each one of my units. I was the business manager for them. I paid the salaries and everything. They'd send me the money and I'd pay them and all. Advance some money if they wanted money and all. So that was the Three Rhythm Rascals. Arlie Crawford on guitar, Al Elkins on bass, and I cannot think of Leonard's name, he was on piano. They were the musicians, the Three Rhythm Rascals. We went all through China, Burma and…
The next unit, they came back, they sent me out, the ETO. That was the European Theater of Operations. Went all through France and England and Germany and all those places.
